laat_vaar.voor: hulle staan baie ver in die buiteruim
laat_vaar.na: hulle is baie ver weg in die buiteruim
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'staan baie ver' reads stiffly for distance; 'is baie ver weg' is the natural Afrikaans phrasing with the same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Staan' is the idiomatic Afrikaans verb for stars in the sky, so 'staan baie ver in die buiteruim' already reads naturally and the proposal is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Verkyker of 'n teleskoop maak dit nog gevaarliker.
na_skrywer.na: Om deur 'n verkyker of 'n teleskoop na die Son te kyk, is nog gevaarliker.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'dit' directly follows 'bied dit nie', where 'dit' is the protection, so it can be read as the protection becoming more dangerous; naming the act of looking removes the ambiguity without changing the warning.
na_skrywer.fout: 'dit' in 'maak dit nog gevaarliker' directly follows 'bied dit nie', where 'dit' is the protection, so a reader can take the protection as the thing made more dangerous.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The pronoun fault is real, but this is a safety warning and the proposal drops the 'without proper protection' scope that 'dit' carried, so the writer must fix it without changing the warning's force.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
